Class LogoSvgSanitizer

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.LogoSvgSanitizer
public final class LogoSvgSanitizer extends Object
Validates and sanitizes user-uploaded SVG logos before persistence. Only a strict allowlist of static SVG elements and safe attributes is accepted; active content, external references, embedded styles, filters and oversized payloads are rejected as a whole. Already-deployed static catalog SVGs are never passed through this sanitizer.
